actions-label.description: Accessible name that opts this assistant reply into the message actions toolbar.

author.description:
Full accessible name for this article, such as "Ava said". Override it to
identify the speaker or localize the default role-specific name.

branch-count.description: Number of reply alternatives. The controls appear when there are at least two.

branch-index.description: One-based index of the displayed reply. Update it after accepting a branch request.

branch-status-label.description: Localized branch status template. Use {index} and {count} for the reply position.

feedback.description:
Current rating for this reply. Assign the saved rating when displaying a
different branch. Select good or bad with the corresponding action control.

icon-name.description:
Decorative event glyph from the ki-icon registry. Search is available
directly. Import other per-icon modules before setting their names.

message-role.description:
The speaker or event kind. The user has a trailing bubble, the assistant has
a leading avatar, and an event is a centered note.

next-branch-label.description: Accessible name for the next branch control.

previous-branch-label.description: Accessible name for the previous branch control.

streaming.description: Show the caret and mark the article busy until this message is complete.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-bg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled background.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-borde.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled border.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-fg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled foreground.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-bg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover background.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-border.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover border.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-fg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover foreground.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-bg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest background.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-border.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest border.

--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-fg.description: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest foreground.

--ki-button-xs-radius.description: dimension used by the button component for xs radius (Button master 8003:300 binds Radius/small-component/xs, the scale a radius mode reassigns).

--ki-control-border-width.description: Stroke width of the boundary of a compact control.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-icon-button-xs-icon-size.description: dimension used by the icon button component for xs icon size (MarsUI Icon/Placeholder_xs 16px — one step above the button xs icon).

--ki-icon-button-xs-size.description: dimension used by the icon button component for xs box (24px square, Figma Space/7xl).

--ki-layout-conversation-avatar-radius.description: Round corner radius of the fallback assistant avatar.

--ki-layout-conversation-bubble-end-radi.description: Smaller radius of the end corner of a user bubble.

--ki-layout-conversation-caret-block-siz.description: Block size of a streaming caret.

--ki-layout-conversation-caret-inline-si.description: Inline size of a streaming caret.

--ki-layout-conversation-user-max-width.description: Maximum width of a user bubble relative to the transcript.

--ki-layout-spacing-2xl.description: The 2xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-3xl.description: The 3xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-9xl.description: The 9xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xl.description: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xxs.description: The xxs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-message-assistant-fg.description: Text ink of an assistant reply on the page surface.

--ki-message-avatar-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter behind the default assistant avatar.

--ki-message-avatar-bg.description: Solid primary container of the default assistant avatar.

--ki-message-avatar-bg-image.description: Optional image over the default assistant avatar background.

--ki-message-avatar-fg.description: Glyph ink inside the default assistant avatar.

--ki-message-event-fg.description: Text and icon ink of a system event on the page surface.

--ki-message-padding.description: Block and inline padding inside a user bubble, in that order.

--ki-message-radius.description: Radius of the user bubble corners.

--ki-message-user-backdrop-filter.description: Complete filter behind the user bubble.

--ki-message-user-bg.description: Solid background of a user bubble.

--ki-message-user-bg-image.description: Optional image over the user bubble background.

--ki-message-user-fg.description: Text ink in a user bubble.

--ki-motion-duration-activity-pulse.description: Period of an indeterminate typing pulse.

--ki-motion-easing-activity-pulse.description: Symmetric easing for fluctuations in a typing pulse.

--ki-outline-low-em.description: semantic color for outline low em.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

component.description: A named chat article styled as a person’s message, assistant reply or event.

ki-branch-change.description: Requests the alternative reply at the one-based index in the event detail.

ki-feedback.description: Reports the selected rating. Persist it or offer optional feedback in the app.

ki-regenerate.description: Requests a new reply when the authored Regenerate action is activated.

actions.description: The group containing slotted follow-up controls.

branches.description: The previous and next controls and the visible branch position.

caret.description: The decorative marker displayed while a message is streaming.

content.description: The body of the article, including any event icon.

message.description: The named article and role-specific layout.

slots.description: Message content, including text or formatted elements.

actions.description:
Follow-up controls supplied by the consumer after the content.
With actions-label, use direct buttons or buttons inside a layout-only
ki-button-group. Mark Regenerate and rating buttons with data-message-action.
The toolbar manages their tab order and includes any reply branch controls.

avatar.description: Optional avatar replacing the assistant’s decorative default.
